pillars.name: Flow & Recoverability
pillars.def: A change reaches production, and can be undone, quickly and safely.

pillars.name: Verification
pillars.def: A change is known to be correct by someone who didn't write it.

pillars.name: Context
pillars.def: The system is understandable to whoever, or whatever, works on it next.

pillars.name: Product Integrity
pillars.def: What ships is deliberate, wanted, and coherent with what's already there.

pillars.name: Control & Accountability
pillars.def: Every change has a named human owner and a bounded blast radius.

levels.lead: The system improves its own hold.
levels.entitlement: The safe-delegation boundary moves itself as evidence accumulates.

levels.lead: The system knows whether it's holding.
levels.entitlement: Delegation calibrated per class of change, from known failure rates.

levels.rest: Constrained mechanically, whether or not anyone remembers.
levels.entitlement: Agents work against machine-checkable constraints; humans review intent and sample the rest.
Agents draft, humans approve everything. Attention is the throughput ceiling.
Delegate nothing. Agents amplify the mess.

l3.flow.head: Recovery tunes itself
points: Rollback drills run unprompted; results retune the gates.
Change-failure rate moves the pipeline's own risk model.
Blast radius shrinks where incidents cluster. No ticket.

l3.verif.head: The suite audits itself
points: Mutation scores set review depth; weak suites lose autonomy.
Escaped defects rewrite the eval set the same week.
Where review adds nothing measurable, it stops being asked.

l3.context.head: Context repairs itself
points: Agent confusion is logged, and opens a documentation defect.
Retrieval misses rewrite the interface that missed them.
Coupling thresholds move on evidence of what actually broke.

l3.product.head: Scope self-corrects
points: Features that miss their predicted outcome retire on schedule.
The bar for new work rises where recent bets underperformed.
Coherence calls carry a hit rate, and the hit rate is public.

l3.control.head: Blast radius self-tunes
points: Permissions narrow where agents have overreached before.
Token budgets reset from observed loop behaviour, not guesswork.
Provenance data changes who may approve what.

lm1.flow.head: No way back
points: Releases are events; nobody is sure how to undo one.
Environments differ in ways only folklore explains.
Recovery is improvised live, by whoever is awake.

lm1.verif.head: Nobody checks
points: Correctness is whatever the author believed at the time.
Tests exist. Nobody knows what they would catch.
Review is a rubber stamp, or absent entirely.

lm1.context.head: Nobody knows
points: Instructions are stale, contradictory, or plain wrong.
Knowledge lives in individuals and leaves when they do.
Nothing describes the system short of reading all of it.

lm1.product.head: Nobody decides
points: Work starts because someone asked, not because demand exists.
Nothing is ever retired. The surface only grows.
No one holds the authority to say no.

lm1.control.head: Nobody owns it
points: Changes land with no traceable human owner.
Agent credentials are shared, broad and unaudited.
Spend is discovered on the invoice.
